method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Turmoil Keeps Oil Elevated: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad risk-off / equity selloff tied to geopolitical escalation and higher oil. Market-wide narrative: risk premium up, liquidity/valuation pressure across sectors.

Equities.title: Dow ends 400 points down as stocks fall, oil spikes after new U.S.-Iran strikes
Equities.reason: US large-cap equity weakness tied to geopolitical risk and oil-driven cost/earnings concerns; reinforces negative market regime for US equities.

Equities.title: Iran says two tankers have hit Hormuz naval mines, attacks regional targets in retaliation to U.S. strikes
Equities.summary: U.S. forces completed another wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday stateside, hitting multiple Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sites across the country.
Equities.reason: Direct escalation in the Gulf raises safe‑haven flows, oil risk premium and systemic risk — a clear negative impulse for global equities.

Equities.title: Government borrowing costs rise anew, adding to pressure on global policymakers
Equities.reason: Rising sovereign yields/bond rout increase discount rates and financing costs — a negative cross-cutting macro force for equities, especially growth/long-duration names.

Equities.title: Dell surges 9% after lifting fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
Equities.summary: Dell sees AI server revenue tripling in fiscal 2027. Six months ago, it was looking for the number to double.
Equities.reason: Company-level beat and materially upgraded AI revenue outlook reinforce the market’s AI leadership narrative and provide positive earnings/sectoral flow for tech equities.

Equities.title: AI capital expenditure forecast to exceed the cost of building railways and the internet
Equities.reason: Large-scale AI capex forecast supports durable structural demand for AI-related hardware, software and services — bullish for sector leadership and multi-year earnings re-rating.

Equities.title: Palo Alto Networks beats quarterly estimates on AI demand, continues acquisition spree
Equities.summary: Palo Alto Networks' stock has nearly doubled this year as AI boosts demand for security detection and response tools
Equities.reason: Earnings beat tied to AI-driven security demand supports the tech/AI earnings theme and helps offset some macro headwinds for the sector.

Equities.title: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI
Equities.summary: Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora said AI is forcing companies to modernize roughly $1 trillion of aging cybersecurity infrastructure that isn’t equipped for attacks.
Equities.reason: CEO commentary highlights large TAM and upgrade cycle tied to AI — constructive for cybersecurity and infrastructure segments within tech.

Equities.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Invests $3.5 Billion in MediaTek. Is This the Next Leg of Its AI Growth?
Equities.reason: Strategic investment by a dominant AI hardware player signals continued capital allocation into AI ecosystem — supportive for AI leadership stocks and related equity flows.

Equities.title: OpenAI says Astra AI model is its first that crosses 'Critical' cybersecurity capability
Equities.summary: OpenAI said it will make Astra available "soon," but access to its cybersecurity capabilities will be limited.
Equities.reason: Product/technology development that underscores AI monetization avenues in security; supportive but limited immediate market impact.

Equities.title: Stock futures are little changed after Wall Street posts third straight losing day
Equities.reason: Near-term market tone remains cautious after multi-day losses — modest negative signal for short-term equity sentiment.

Equities.title: U.S. House votes to avoid government shutdown amid GOP hard-liner resistance
Equities.summary: The U.S. House on Tuesday voted in favor of a short-term spending measure that would avoid a government shutdown until after November's midterm election.
Equities.reason: Political risk reduced by avoiding an imminent shutdown — small supportive effect on market risk appetite.

Rates.title: Global bond yields soar to multi-decade highs as Middle East turmoil reignites inflation fears
Rates.summary: Bond yields surged across major markets Tuesday as U.S.-Iran hostilities revived energy and inflation risks, with Japan and U.K. yields at multi-decade highs.
Rates.reason: Major cross-market bond selloff driven by geopolitical shock and renewed inflation/energy risk. In the Rates framework rising yields = negative for bonds; multi‑market, multi‑decade highs increase relevance as a broad macro regime move.

Rates.title: Bond selloff deepens as inflation risks, oil prices jolt markets
Rates.reason: Reinforces the dominant narrative of a widening bond selloff on inflation and oil-price shocks. Strong relevance because Reuters piece highlights market breadth and persistence of yield moves, but slightly lower than primary geopolitical headlines.

Rates.title: US launches further strikes on Iran as conflict flares up
Rates.summary: Escalation pushes oil prices higher and sends Treasury yields to day’s highs as investors fret over new bout of inflation
Rates.reason: Direct geopolitical escalation boosting oil and inflation expectations, which translates into higher Treasury yields. High relevance due to immediate policy/geopolitical shock transmission into rates.

Rates.title: China-US Yield Gap Nears Record High as Treasury Selloff Deepens
Rates.reason: Widening China–US yield differential highlights cross-border flow impacts and pressure on Treasuries; important for global rates and reserve/capital flow dynamics. Negative because it signals further US yield strength/selloff.

Rates.title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease
Rates.summary: The policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has prevailed above the Fed's 2% target.
Rates.reason: Explicit Fed signalling of further hikes if inflation persists pushes rate expectations and yields higher. Central‑bank forward guidance is directly rate‑market relevant, increasing downside for bond prices.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Takata says central bank need to consider a broad range of options on monetary policy response
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Hajime Takata said on Wednesday that the central bank needs a different response from conventional semi-annual rate hike pace.
Rates.reason: BoJ commentary suggesting non‑standard or faster policy moves can lift Japanese yields and alter global rates dynamics. Relevant to rates but more regionally focused and conditional, so moderate weight.

Rates.title: Australia posts second-quarter growth of 2.1%, beating expectations
Rates.summary: The GDP print will allow the Reserve Bank of Australia room to go ahead with its policy tightening as it seeks to curb inflation.
Rates.reason: Stronger GDP increases odds of further RBA tightening, which pushes Australian yields up. Regionally relevant rates news with moderate global spillovers.

Rates.title: China Bond Sales Set to Accelerate, Putting Focus on PBOC
Rates.reason: Faster government bond issuance increases supply and could push yields higher; also raises questions about PBOC response. Relevant to global rates via supply dynamics and potential central‑bank intervention.

FX.title: Euro: ECB guidance may trigger asymmetric downside risks - Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke notes that markets are fully pricing an European Central Bank (ECB) rate hike next week after Euro Area inflation rose to 3.3%, but she doubts further tightening beyond September as projections show inflation declining into 2027.
FX.reason: ECB-hike pricing already priced in limits the euro upside; overall tilt is modestly EUR-negative in a USD-hawkish environment. Medium relevance as it’s ECB-forward but not a major regime shock.

FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes the Dollar is holding gains after Kevin Warsh’s hawkish comments and a renewed spike in energy prices, with markets now expecting a Federal Reserve rate hike in September.
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength narrative tied to hawkish Fed commentary and rising hike odds — high relevance for USD-centric FX flows and broad pair moves.

FX.reason: Direct USD impact: stronger US inflation -> higher Fed hike probability -> USD support. Timely macro datapoint with clear transmission to FX.

FX.title: ECB's Nagel: Markets see over 95% probability of a September rate hike
FX.summary: The European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said on Wednesday that markets see over 95% chance of a September rate hike.
FX.reason: Very high market-implied probability of an ECB hike is EUR-supportive (GBP/USD/AUD/USD-centric interpretation: EUR strength = positive). Moderately relevant given offset from Fed dynamics.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as US Dollar gains on Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: USD/IDR extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 17,810 during the European hours on Wednesday.

Commodities.reason: Bloomberg report of fresh attacks/risks to Hormuz reopening is a material supply-shock narrative supportive of higher oil prices; strong market-moving relevance.

Commodities.reason: Silver is being weighed by rising US Treasury yields and hawkish Fed expectations, a clear negative for precious metals with moderate relevance.

Commodities.reason: Copper is sensitive to global growth risks; stall in the rally from demand concerns is a meaningful negative signal for industrial metals.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025

Commodities.reason: Growth in Nigerian petroleum shipments (Dangote refinery) adds seaborne product supply to markets, a modestly bearish fundamental for refined product balances.

Commodities.title: Corn Pushes Higher to Close August, as Conditions Slip

Commodities.title: What to Know About Venezuelan Energy Following Trump’s Oil Deal
Commodities.reason: Policy/deal that could reopen Venezuelan oil to markets implies potential incremental supply; material medium-term negative for crude prices though outcomes remain uncertain.

Crypto.title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
Crypto.reason: Regulatory tightening for stablecoins (100% reserves + yield ban) reduces product innovation and yield-bearing stablecoin use in DeFi, likely negative for risk-taking and crypto lending/yield products; material policy change for market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF Buyers Return as $80,000 Level Tests Market Rally
Crypto.reason: Renewed institutional ETF buying is a direct liquidity inflow into BTC and a powerful, market-supporting narrative for price discovery and sustained demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin enters ‘Rektember’ as rate-hike risk combines with seasonality to threaten rally
Crypto.reason: Macro (rate-hike) risk and seasonality framing point to higher-for-longer yields weighing on risk assets including crypto; important macro headwind for the market.

Crypto.title: Solana, ether, xrp lead majors slide as Iran strikes drive a broad risk selloff
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical shock (Iran strikes) triggering broad risk-off flows that hit major crypto tokens — a near-term negative for market liquidity and risk sentiment.

Crypto.reason: Revenue-driven adoption (Robinhood Chain) boosting on-chain activity and token economics for Arbitrum — positive for crypto-native revenue models and token demand.

Crypto.title: A China indicator that greases risk-taking in stocks and bitcoin is flashing red
Crypto.reason: China risk-appetite metric turning negative implies reduced risk-taking flows that historically correlate with weaker bitcoin and broader crypto risk assets.

Crypto.reason: Large-scale illicit flows and security incidents raise censorship/regulatory and reputation risks for crypto platforms, increasing political pressure and potential onshoring/oversight moves.

Crypto.title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
Crypto.reason: Shift of futures volume to regulated venues (CME) indicates rising institutional participation in crypto derivatives, supportive for market maturity and demand for tokens like XRP.
